messages:
raj: Quick check — we discovered phone numbers in customer support messages being sent to the embeddings pipeline. Need a scrub policy before we push more data.
elaine: Are these prod customer messages or test data?
raj: Prod. People paste callbacks in text like:
```json
{
  "message": "Can you call me at +1 415-555-1212 about billing?",
  "user_id": "U123"
}
```
We currently hash emails with HMAC+KMS at ingestion, but phone numbers are flowing untouched into embeddings.
tammy: Phones are PII. Short answer: do not store raw. Either strip or pseudonymize with HMAC.
raj: Impl question — if we HMAC the number and keep the hashed token in the plain text that we embed, does that preserve search behavior?
elaine: No — embedding model won't understand the numeric semantics. Hashing in-text just creates an arbitrary token, so semantic similarity will be lost. If you want to support lookups by phone, keep the embedding of the cleaned text and store the consistent HMAC as a metadata field on the vector. Then you can exact-match on metadata.
tammy: +1. Recommended pattern:
- remove phone numbers from the text before generating embeddings
- compute HMAC(phone, KMS_KEY) and store as secure metadata field phone_hmac
- restrict access to phone_hmac via RBAC and require a valid justification ticket for any access
raj: Sounds good. I'll implement: regex -> hmac(kms) -> cleaned_text -> embed(cleaned_text) -> vec.metadata.phone_hmac = hmac. Question: can sec approve a short staging exception to capture raw payloads for debugging (we need to ensure regex is matching edge cases)?
tammy: No raw full-capture in staging unless it's ephemeral and auditable. If you must capture raw for 1-time debug, use ephemeral storage with explicit TTL (<= 6h), access limited to named engineers, and audit-bot logging. Create a ticket and list scopes.
lisa: I can approve an ephemeral capture for staging for up to 6 hours if you create a ticket that includes the reason, list of people, and cleanup steps. Also require PR link and the KMS key name you'll use for HMAC.
raj: I'll open the ticket now. Ticket: LINK-1234 — description: "embeddings: phone scrub regex verification + short capture". PR will reference LINK-1234. Regex we'll test: `/((?:\+?1[-.\s]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4})/`
elaine: Will run QA against a seeded sample set after you land the PR.
audit-bot: Access granted for LINK-1234 to raj, elaine. TTL set to 6h. All accesses will be logged.
lisa: Please also add a line in the data-handling docs and update the eval corpus to exclude real phone numbers.
raj: Thanks — PR will include a small doc update. I'll tag you when ready. :thumbsup:
